what: per book, per served place (chapter:verse:w), the served piece rows with no English, each with the lane's class: the page finds the row by its pi, src, kind, reading, from and to (the served row's first six slots) and prints the class's words; a row the lane mended is under mended, served with its English now or withheld by the served rules
mended_row: the served rule that withholds it, or null

classes.name: NO_RECORD
classes.def: the row names no record (rid null; the claim's rec [])
classes.page: the record is in records-new or v2; the claims patch names it where it can

classes.name: TAHOT_PIECE_CROSSES_PARTS
classes.def: A7: the TAHOT record's covered parts hold no code point but U+0020 and the piece's letters lie across two or more of the line's lettered parts; no record mends it
classes.page: TAHOT divides the word otherwise: its English stands on its own parts, not on this piece

classes.name: TAHOT_PRINTS_NOTHING
classes.def: A5: the TAHOT record's covered parts of column 4 hold no code point but U+0020

classes.name: BAKE_LOST_SLICE
classes.def: the source's english for the row's morpheme is not empty but the served row is
classes.page: the source prints English the served row lacks; the claims patch carries the ranges

classes.name: MACULA_GLOSS_ONLY
classes.def: MACULA english empty, gloss not empty

classes.name: MACULA_PRINTS_NOTHING
classes.def: MACULA english empty and gloss empty for every lettered record the claim names
classes.page: MACULA prints nothing there: a typed gap with MACULA's name on it

classes.name: UNDEFINED
classes.def: none of the above; a numbered amendment must define it

served_blank_rows.what: the ledger rows that still stand in the served store with no English; equal to the store's rows with no English

mended_served.what: ledger rows the claims patch mended, served with their English now

mended_withheld.what: ledger rows the claims patch mended whose mended claim the served rules withhold (a join of two or more ranges: joins_whole_word or joins_run)
